task.title: P6-173: Close two kill-verified DFC test gaps
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 9 — Dev loop, tests and test strength). Original id: P6-173. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**DFC test gaps, both kill-verified** (was `P6-072a` + `P6-072b`): dropping the `faces.len() < 2` guard in `CardFaceSummary::build` (`shared/catalog.rs:200`) survives the shared suite 26/26 — only `CardDetail::flip_faces`' twin guard at `:142` is tested — so the "fail closed" claim's fewer-than-two-faces leg is untested and a one-element `faces` list still ships over the wire to native clients; and no test asserts the mana-cost / type-line / stats swap, because the e2e fixture card has no P/T on either face, so a stats-pinned-to-front-face mutation analytically survives every unit test, all four e2e tests and the Android probe (`stats_line` at `cards.rs:87` has zero test references anywhere).
